label: out of session
description: The session has not started yet or is already over: the car is in the paddock or the pit lane, drives to the track, has left the track, or is parked. From the start of the video until the car joins the track, and from leaving the track until the end of the video.

label: warm up
description: From joining the track until the car first drives at full pace: the slow first lap.

label: clear
description: The car drives at pace on the track. No other car is close ahead or alongside, nothing lies on the road, and the car stays on the tarmac and under control. A car further ahead that I am not catching does not change this.

label: offtrack
description: My car leaves the tarmac with at least two wheels: grass, gravel or run-off area is under or directly ahead of the car, often with a shaking picture or dust. Ends when the car is back on the tarmac.

label: sliding
description: My car loses grip but stays on the track: the view swings sideways more than the road bends, the steering is corrected quickly, tyres may squeal. Ends when the car drives straight and stable again.

label: overtaking
description: A car ahead of me comes closer, I move alongside it and pass it, and it disappears from the picture behind me. Starts when I pull alongside; ends when the other car is out of view.

label: overtaken
description: Another car appears at the side of the picture coming from behind, passes me and moves ahead. Starts 3 seconds before the other car first appears, so the whole process is covered; ends when it is clearly ahead and has pulled away.

label: held up
description: A car ahead of me holds me up: I am close behind it, I am not falling back, and it dictates my line and speed. Ends when I start to overtake it, when it pulls away, or when it leaves the track ahead of me.

label: obstacle
description: Something is on or beside the road that should not be there: debris, car parts, fluid, gravel thrown onto the tarmac, or a stopped car. Starts when it becomes visible; ends when I have passed it.

label: crash
description: My car can no longer drive on at pace: it hits something, is hit by another car, or stops with a mechanical failure. Lasts until the end of the video unless the car drives on.

label: cooling
description: From the moment the car stops driving at pace at the end of the session until it leaves the track: the slow final lap.
